nameEn: Manufacture of railway locomotives and rolling stock
description: This class includes the manufacture of railway and tramway locomotives and rolling stock.
includes: manufacture of diesel, electric and steam railway locomotives
manufacture of self-propelled railway and tramway coaches, vans and trucks: electric multiple units, diesel multiple units, railbuses
manufacture of railway and tramway rolling stock, not self-propelled: passenger coaches, freight wagons, maintenance wagons
manufacture of railway and tramway track fixtures and fittings: rails, switches, crossings, sleepers
manufacture of specialised parts for railway and tramway locomotives and rolling stock: bogies, axles, wheels, brakes
excludes: manufacture of railway signalling equipment, see 2790
